verdict_text:
YES

The keep index is built as `segments=1, seg_size=2048, block=128`, i.e. head blocks 0–15 with head 5 skipped, yielding exactly rows/columns `0..639` then `768..2047` in order; it is applied along dim 0 for q/k/v and dim 1 for o_proj across all 16 layers, leaving every other tensor untouched. The four shape assertions and the 114-tensor count check run before `save_file`, and the output is the single file `out/T2/model.safetensors`. Dtypes are preserved by `index_select`, and `.contiguous()` avoids any stride issue on write. (This assumes the unshown `_ckpt.load_checkpoint` merges the two shards faithfully; nothing in the script itself deviates from the specification.)
